name: Denise Welch
bio: Jacqueline Denise Welch is an English actress, television personality, writer and broadcaster. Her roles include Natalie Barnes in the ITV soap opera Coronation Street, Steph Haydock in Waterloo Road, and Trish Minniver in Hollyoaks. Welch also appears as a regular panellist on the ITV chat show Loose Women.
